report.raw: {"schema_version":"m0-report-v2","assessment_status":"completed","conclusion":"partial","summary":"The alert is firing because checkout's PlaceOrder fails whenever it charges the card: the call into oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge is rejected by the payment service itself with the exact error 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' (gRPC Unknown), and a fraction of PlaceOrder requests therefore end as gRPC code 13 errors. In the hour ending 2026-11-03T19:01:23Z roughly half of checkout PlaceOrder spans were errors (≈47–51 error vs ≈51–52 non-error span increments in each evaluation) and every PlaceOrder error row examined carries that single 'failed to charge card … Invalid token' description; compared with a full 24h of hourly data the same failure is intermittent and at its highest hourly count in the final hour, with a 5-minute window (ending 18:55:02) where all sampled PlaceOrder spans were errors. The same failure count appears in checkout's Charge client spans (rpc status 2), frontend POST //api/checkout, frontend-proxy ingress/egress and load-generator POST spans, so the failing checkout POST is visible at the edge. Payment's error is raised inside its own charge handler (charge.js:37); the only downstream spans visible in the failing payment traces are an internal 'charge' span and a flagd ResolveFloat evaluation that completed with rpc.grpc.status_code 0, so no failing dependency was observed behind payment. Why payment judges the token invalid (flag/chaos-style rejection vs. malformed card input from the caller) is not resolvable with the integrated sources: flag values, payment pod logs and change history are unavailable. checkout's other dependencies (cart, product-catalog, currency, shipping) showed no error spans or only rpc status 0. incident.acceptance_step: eval-suite development baseline (not an acceptance step)

stimulus.question: Checkout is reported to show elevated errors in the OTel Demo. Using the authorized metrics range query and trace search for the last 5 minutes, determine whether checkout and its dependency calls (payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping, email) show failures or elevated latency, cite trace ids, and return a json investigation report.

claims.text: checkout PlaceOrder server spans (service_name=checkout, span_name=oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, service_version 2.0.2) end in error with otel.status_description 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' and span status rpc.grpc.status_code=13; e.g. span_id 997d3a5d1ff83226 in trace_id ab1f986869f1872d740a3f94e0037726.

Over 2026-11-03T18:00:02Z–19:01:23Z the hourly span counts for span_name oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder in service_name checkout are STATUS_CODE_ERROR ≈47.2 / 48.0 / 51.2 and STATUS_CODE_UNSET ≈52.3 / 52.1 / 51.2, i.e. roughly half of the PlaceOrder spans were errors; the same query shows no error series for checkout's GetCart, EmptyCart, prepareOrderItems, CurrencyService/Convert, ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, ShippingService/GetQuote and ShipOrder spans.

The failing checkout traces show the call edge PlaceOrder -> Charge -> payment: checkout span 997d3a5d1ff83226 is the parent of checkout's client span 1ae861c00e9f0e6c (operation oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, rpc.grpc.status_code=2, status_description 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold'), and payment's server span 90596ff298553bad in the same trace_id ab1f986869f1872d740a3f94e0037726 lists parent spanID 1ae861c00e9f0e6c.

payment service Charge server spans (service_name=payment, span_name=grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, service_version 2.0.2) carry ERROR status with grpc.error_message and exception.message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' and stack 'Error: Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold at module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13)', i.e. the error is raised inside payment's own handler rather than returned from a downstream call.

payment's Charge error volume over 2026-11-03T18:00:02Z–19:01:23Z is STATUS_CODE_ERROR ≈47.2 / 48.0 / 51.2 versus STATUS_CODE_UNSET ≈52.3 / 52.1 / 51.2, and the only other payment operations in that window are span_name charge (UNSET ≈99.5–102.5), grpc.flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat (UNSET ≈8.0–9.0) and grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, so roughly half of Charge spans failed in the hour.

The 24h hourly view of payment's Charge span (increase over 3600s, step 3600) shows the failure is intermittent rather than a single step: STATUS_CODE_ERROR 8.14 at 2026-11-02T20:01:23Z, 0 in most hours, 9.15 at 01:01:23Z, 32.54 at 13:01:23Z, 5.09 at 14:01:23Z, 0 at 15:01:23Z, 42.72 at 16:01:23Z, 21.36 at 17:01:23Z, 0 at 18:01:23Z and 51.86 at 2026-11-03T19:01:23Z, against STATUS_CODE_UNSET between ≈49.8 and ≈103.7 per hour.

At 5-minute resolution over 2026-11-03T18:05:02Z–19:00:02Z, checkout PlaceOrder error counts are non-zero in 8 of the 12 evaluations (5.0, 5.0, 1.25, 7.5, 10.0, 3.75, 1.25, 7.5); the window ending 18:55:02Z has 7.5 errors and 0 UNSET (all sampled PlaceOrder spans in error, matching a 100% ratio claim), while the window ending 19:00:02Z has 0 errors and 11.25 UNSET.

checkout's client-side rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count splits by rpc_grpc_status_code only on the Charge call: oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge has rpc_grpc_status_code='2' at ≈48.0 / 48.2 / 49.1 and '0' at ≈53.1 / 52.3 / 51.1 per hour, while oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert, CartService/GetCart, CartService/EmptyCart (including code '9' = 0), ProductCatalogService/GetProduct and ShippingService/GetQuote/ShipOrder appear only with rpc_grpc_status_code='0'.

frontend error spans over the hour are POST ≈47.2 / 48.0 / 51.2 and 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' ≈47.2 / 48.0 / 51.2, i.e. the same counts as the PlaceOrder and Charge failures, plus a much smaller GET ≈1.0, '/api/data' ≈1.0 and grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds ≈1.0.

At the entry points, frontend-proxy error spans are span_name ingress ≈48.2 / 49.1 / 52.3 and 'router frontend egress' ≈48.2 / 49.1 / 52.3 per hour, and load-generator error spans are POST ≈47.2 / 48.0 / 51.2 with GET ≈1.0, matching the PlaceOrder error counts.

payment's only visible downstream activity in the failing traces is an internal 'charge' span with no status tag and a grpc.flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat span whose status tag is rpc.grpc.status_code=0 (trace_id ab1f986869f1872d740a3f94e0037726, span_id 6ae5ad457f27b447); hourly, the only flagd-related client spans are under service_name payment and are STATUS_CODE_UNSET at ≈8.0–9.0 per hour.

flagd's own error spans in the hour are confined to span_name flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream (STATUS_CODE_ERROR ≈8.0–8.2, STATUS_CODE_UNSET ≈4.0–4.1), while flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveBoolean (≈77.4–76.4) and flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat (≈108.5–110.4) appear with STATUS_CODE_UNSET only and no error series.

Error spans in the hour are not limited to the checkout path but are also reported for unrelated operations: per-service error counts are cart 0 and product-catalog 0, while ad ≈7.0, recommendation ≈6.0 and flagd ≈8.0 exist on their own operations (flagd on EventStream), and no error series was observed for accounting, currency, email, image-provider, kafka, quote or shipping in this query.

A single 5-minute evaluation ending 2026-11-03T19:01:00Z returned PlaceOrder STATUS_CODE_ERROR 0 and STATUS_CODE_UNSET 7.5 (one point only, metric samples end ≈19:01:00–19:01:20), while the trace slices contain payment/checkout Charge error spans started at 1793732431.854s, 1793732440.655s and 1793732465.202s (19:00:31Z, 19:00:40Z, 19:01:05Z), so the sparse traces_span_metrics scrape does not reproduce the last minutes exactly.

Payment rejects a large fraction of Charge requests through its own token-validation logic in charge.js, most plausibly a probabilistic/feature-flag-driven failure variant: the error text embeds an application attribute ('app.loyalty.level=gold') and payment performs a flagd ResolveFloat evaluation, while the failures are intermittent (~50% in the last hour, bursts across the previous day) rather than constant. Flag values and flagd configuration are not observable with the integrated sources, so this remains unverified.

The charge requests arriving at payment carry a card token payment considers invalid (e.g. a token generated by the load-generator/frontend checkout flow), so payment's validation fails on those requests; checkout's own downstream calls to cart, product-catalog, currency and shipping all return rpc status 0, which is consistent with the request payload rather than with checkout plumbing being the trigger. Request payloads and card tokens are not observable here, so this is unverified.

A failing flagd dependency is not supported as the cause of the Charge rejections: payment's ResolveFloat client span in the failing trace carries rpc.grpc.status_code=0, all hourly flagd client spans under payment are STATUS_CODE_UNSET, and flagd's own ResolveFloat/ResolveBoolean server spans show no error series; the only flagd errors are on flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream, a different operation with no observed link to charge.

A checkout-side defect independent of payment is not supported: every PlaceOrder error row examined carries the payment-originated 'Invalid token' description and rpc.grpc.status_code=13, checkout's Charge client spans fail with rpc.grpc.status_code=2 in the same counts, and checkout's other dependency calls (Convert, GetCart, GetProduct, GetQuote, ShipOrder, EmptyCart) show only rpc status 0 with no error series.

report_parsed.summary: The alert is firing because checkout's PlaceOrder fails whenever it charges the card: the call into oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge is rejected by the payment service itself with the exact error 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' (gRPC Unknown), and a fraction of PlaceOrder requests therefore end as gRPC code 13 errors. In the hour ending 2026-11-03T19:01:23Z roughly half of checkout PlaceOrder spans were errors (≈47–51 error vs ≈51–52 non-error span increments in each evaluation) and every PlaceOrder error row examined carries that single 'failed to charge card … Invalid token' description; compared with a full 24h of hourly data the same failure is intermittent and at its highest hourly count in the final hour, with a 5-minute window (ending 18:55:02) where all sampled PlaceOrder spans were errors. The same failure count appears in checkout's Charge client spans (rpc status 2), frontend POST //api/checkout, frontend-proxy ingress/egress and load-generator POST spans, so the failing checkout POST is visible at the edge. Payment's error is raised inside its own charge handler (charge.js:37); the only downstream spans visible in the failing payment traces are an internal 'charge' span and a flagd ResolveFloat evaluation that completed with rpc.grpc.status_code 0, so no failing dependency was observed behind payment. Why payment judges the token invalid (flag/chaos-style rejection vs. malformed card input from the caller) is not resolvable with the integrated sources: flag values, payment pod logs and change history are unavailable. checkout's other dependencies (cart, product-catalog, currency, shipping) showed no error spans or only rpc status 0. The Alertmanager alert fired again at 2026-11-03T19:01:43Z.
